mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id, chapter_name, chapter_num, word_count, create_time FROM book_chapter WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY chapter_num ASC
SELECT id FROM book_chapter WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND chapter_num < #{chapterNum} ORDER BY chapter_num DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM book_chapter WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND chapter_num > #{chapterNum} ORDER BY chapter_num ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_chapter (book_id, chapter_name, chapter_num, word_count, create_time) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{chapterName}, #{chapterNum}, COALESCE(#{wordCount}, 0), #{createTime})
